statement: ∀ (N : ℕ) [NeZero N] (a b : ZMod N) (f : ZMod N → ℂ), let T := fun (g : ZMod N → ℂ) n => g (n+a); let M := fun (g : ZMod N → ℂ) n => ZMod.stdAddChar (b*n)*g n; ∀ n, T (M f) n = ZMod.stdAddChar (a*b)*M (T f) n
